summary: Documented in public reporting as the vehicle used to block MP George Koimburi before his abduction outside a Juja church on 25 May 2025; the MP was found beaten the next morning near Ruiru. The registration was reported by Kenyan media covering the incident.

The white Subaru linked in public reporting and by Senator Okiya Omtatah to the 24 December 2024 abduction of cartoonist Gideon Kibet (Kibet Bull) in Nairobi; the victim was found alive near Luanda, Vihiga County, on 6 January 2025.

Pattern documented by KNCHR during the 25 June 2026 protests: three Subaru station wagons carrying more than ten armed men in civilian clothes took six arrested protesters from an isolated area where a police truck had abandoned them; a concealed Subaru was used in a separate Githurai abduction; and Subaru vehicles were used again when the six were dumped on Langata Road and Ngong Road at about 04:00 on 27 June. The make recurs across abduction, transfer and dump sites in the same 48-hour window, which is exactly the pattern the four-zone rule is built to surface.
